_about.purpose: Single source of truth for logging INFRASTRUCTURE + request-traffic capture. Mirrors config/ports.json: edit HERE, not in code. Consumed by app/core/logging_settings.py (loaded by app/core/logging_config.py and app/main.py).
_about.not_here: The console log LEVEL is intentionally NOT in this file. It is a live, user-facing setting owned by config/settings.json -> config.log_level, edited at runtime via the Settings page (integrations_config.py) so it changes without a restart. Everything else about logging lives here so it stops being scattered across hardcoded constants and NMA_* env vars.
consumed_by: packages/backend/app/core/logging_config.py (rotation, retention, JSON output, PII redaction, third-party logger levels)
packages/backend/app/core/traffic_log.py (ring buffer size, traffic.log sink, capture-all)

fields.json_logs: Emit structured JSON logs to file handlers (machine-parseable).
fields.pii_redaction: Mask emails/phones/IPs/paths/API keys in every log record.
fields.rotation.max_bytes: Rotate a log file once it exceeds this size (bytes).
fields.rotation.backup_count: How many rotated files to keep per log.
fields.retention_days: Delete log files older than this on startup.
fields.third_party_levels: Per-logger level overrides for noisy libraries (uvicorn.access, etc.).
fields.traffic.enabled: Record every HTTP request into the live traffic ring buffer.
fields.traffic.buffer_size: Max requests held in memory for the Admin live-traffic view.
fields.traffic.log_file: File name under output/logs for the append-only request journal.
fields.traffic.capture_all: Write every recorded request to traffic.log (not just slow ones).
fields.traffic.slow_ms: Requests slower than this are also flagged in the text app log at INFO.
fields.traffic.excluded_paths: Paths never recorded (health/SSE/traffic polling) to avoid noise + self-feedback.
fields.sentry.dsn: Optional Sentry DSN for shipping structured logs/errors. null = disabled.
fields.analytics.auto_ingest: Background task that ingests new log lines into the analytics store so the Log Analytics dashboard is not stuck at zero. false = manual 'Ingest Logs' only.
fields.analytics.interval_seconds: How often the auto-ingest loop runs.
fields.analytics.sources: Log file keys to ingest (app, error, queue, comfyui, ollama).
fields.analytics.limit: Max new events ingested per source per pass.
fields.presence.session_gap_seconds: Gap under which consecutive requests form one session.
fields.presence.people: Ordered roster. Each person is traffic-source (client_ip + activity_labels) or commit-source (commit_match).
fields.presence.people[].activity_labels: Ordered prefix->label map for traffic-source activity; the 'default' key is the fallback.
